summary: Tested Inventory & Go-Live Gate panel (backend + frontend). Backend: all 9 HTTP tests in new test_iter_golive_inventory_http.py pass (inventory/pending shape+403, DELETE orphan-bot success/409/404/403, 4-eyes expectation propose+same-admin-rejected+different-admin-approve, promote_admin.py exit codes 1/2). Frontend: panel renders at /admin/brokers with all testids present (inventory-golive-panel, inventory-gate-status GATE FAIL, inventory-count-accounts, inventory-count-bots, inventory-expected, inventory-hash, inventory-admin-count, expectation inputs, expectation-fill-current, expectation-propose, expectation-approve, hash-propose, hash-confirm, inventory-orphans, 50 orphan-bot-delete-* rows). Fill-current enables Propose; expectation-approve disabled (no pending); hash-propose disabled (violations present) with 'requires zero violations above' hint; two-admin preview shows admin_count>=2 so second-admin-hint hidden. One React warning noted — duplicate key in violations list.

ui_bugs.issue: React 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning — violations.map uses key={v} but preview data has ~60 identical strings ('R9-LIVE: enabled account/bot relation broken (account_enabled=True, bot_enabled=False)') producing duplicate keys. Harmless rendering-wise but spams console. Fix: use key={`${i}-${v}`}.

action_items: LOW: InventoryGoLivePanel.jsx — change violations list key from `key={v}` to `key={`${i}-${v}`}` (or dedupe) to silence duplicate-key console warnings when the same violation repeats across many accounts.

NOTE: `use current` button fills bots field with 0 when there are 0 enabled bots. The Propose button then enables (string '0' is truthy to the `!exp.bots` guard) but backend returns 400 expectation_invalid 'bots must equal enabled'. Consider surfacing the server message or client-side pre-check so admins don't need to open a devtools tab to see why propose failed.
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryGoLivePanel.jsx line 66: `violations.map((v) => <li key={v}>)` produces duplicate React keys for repeated violation strings (preview reproduces this ~60x on load). Low-impact but noisy.

InventoryGoLivePanel.jsx: expectation-propose enablement checks only `!exp.accounts || !exp.enabled || !exp.bots` so a leading-zero value is valid client-side but may fail the server's accounts/enabled/bots>=0 and bots==enabled invariants. Consider mirroring the server validation in the dialog so the toast error is actionable.
promote_admin.py docstring mentions `docker compose exec -T backend` which does not match this preview container (service runs via supervisor). Harmless but misleading.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable surfaces (panel + testids + enable/disable state)

test_credentials: admin@trading.bot and admin@stoicaibot.com — both from TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD / ADMIN_PASSWORD in backend/.env.
